name: @nexus/trading-decision
description: Phase 10A-1 Production Trading Decision Engine — pure, deterministic, fail-closed derivation of actionable TradingDecisions (entry/stop/targets, R:R, scores, regime, explainability, multi-timeframe consensus, opportunity ranking) from an admitted EngineSignal + its FeatureSnapshot. IO-free; the decision/side/confidence are carried VERBATIM from the signal engine (single source of truth). Consumed by the web tier.
